hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git fetch --quiet origin 2>/dev/null; if git pull --ff-only --quiet origin main 2>/dev/null; then echo "Pulled latest from origin/main. Read docs/team/ (GOALS, TODO, UPDATES, DECISIONS) before working."; else echo "WARNING: could not fast-forward to origin/main (local changes or diverged). Run: git pull --rebase origin main"; fi; git status -sb | head -5
